Approved evidence

V7 / Darwin

org.v7

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. Darwin is an annotation/data management software offer. It supports AI-assisted masks/segmentation, video tracking, pre-labeling and multistage reviews. The product also advertises specialist-service access for medical and language/RLHF tasks. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
